value.title: next.run() contract

acceptanceCriteria.text: A middleware that calls `next.run()` twice gets `IllegalStateException` from the second call, and the downstream middleware and handler ran once. [D-122; T35]

A middleware that calls `next.run()` after `res.send("x")` completed the response gets `IllegalStateException` and no downstream middleware runs; a `Next` kept and called after the request ended (from the test thread after the in-memory exchange finished) throws `IllegalStateException`. [D-123] Decision: `next.run()` throws when the response is `COMPLETED` or `ABORTED` or the request has ended, and no downstream step runs. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-4-4 SDS-AC-10]

A middleware that records a marker after `next.run()` returns sees the handler's marker already recorded and `res.isCommitted()` true for a handler that called `res.send(...)`. [D-124] Decision: an exception thrown downstream propagates out of `next.run()` unchanged and the dispatcher hands it to the error path once, so a middleware may wrap `next.run()` in `try`/`catch`. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-4-4 SDS-AC-11]
A middleware that writes `res.status(401).send("no")` and returns without `next.run()` delivers `401` with body `no`, and the later middleware and the handler record no call. [D-125; T36]

Calling `next.error(e)` after `next.run()` in the same invocation, or `next.run()` after `next.error(e)`, throws `IllegalStateException`; `next.error(null)` throws `NullPointerException`. [D-122; D-116] Decision: `next.run()` and `next.error(e)` together count as the single continuation of one invocation. Decision: `next.error(null)` throws before the continuation is consumed. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-4-4 SDS-AC-12]
`next.run()` runs the downstream chain on the calling thread, and no middleware or handler runs after the dispatcher returned to the adapter for a non-streaming response. [D-128]

value.requirement: The system shall let each middleware invocation continue the chain at most once through `next.run()` or `next.error(e)`, return from `next.run()` only after every downstream middleware and the handler returned, deliver the response of a middleware that responds without calling `next.run()` with no later middleware or handler run, and throw `IllegalStateException` for a second continuation within one invocation and for a continuation after the response completed or the request ended.
value.rationale: Covers D-122, D-123, D-124, D-125 and D-128 (synchronous execution). The unfinished-response case of D-126 is in the wave 4 successor of FR-HTTP-006. T35, T36.
